source_summary: Ink landscape with a shaded garden pavilion at left, dense foreground trees and central willows, a rocky bank with a small figure, and an open lake receding to distant low hills on the right. Calligraphy and margins are excluded.

motifs.name: left_foreground_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense grove at the far left foreground: gnarled leaning trunks, dark clustered foliage, bare upper branches, hanging willow-like strands, low shrubs, and the small rocky earth base beneath the trees. Exclude the pavilion, fence, and neighboring central willow mass.
must_preserve: ink-wash ground mounds and small rock dots

motifs.name: pavilion_with_reclining_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the open garden pavilion and enclosure: sloping roof or awning, upright posts, interior couch with a reclining scholar, and the angled lattice fence below. Avoid surrounding tree canopies except where they directly overlap the pavilion silhouette.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and eave lines
reclining scholar outline and robe strokes
light interior wash and platform edges

motifs.name: central_willow_tree_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the large central willow cluster rising from the middle bank, with multiple intertwined trunks and heavy curtains of drooping leaves. Exclude pavilion details, foreground rocks, and distant shore where possible.
must_preserve: layered gray wash behind leaf masses
root flare and lower trunk texture

motifs.name: background_grove_mist_screen
motifs.description: Isolate the pale rear screen of trees behind and around the central willows: soft vertical tree masses, gray ink washes, blurred foliage tops, and misty openings between trunks. Do not include calligraphy or foreground pavilion details.
must_preserve: subtle tonal layering behind darker trees

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank_with_figure
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground bank stretching from left to center, including layered shoreline rocks, sloping earth strokes, scattered ink dots, stepping path marks, and the small standing scholar figure near the pavilion path.
must_preserve: small standing figure posture and robe lines
pale wash transitions along the bank edge

motifs.name: midground_peninsula_willow_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the midground peninsula projecting into the water, including the leaning willow trunk at the water edge, low shrubs, curved shoreline, exposed rocks, and rippled ink-wash landforms.
must_preserve: leaning tree trunk and drooping branch strokes

motifs.name: right_lake_surface_islets
motifs.description: Isolate the open lake surface on the right and lower right, with sparse horizontal water lines, pale wash bands, small isolated rocks or islets, and quiet negative space. Exclude distant hills if separable.

motifs.name: distant_right_hills_flats
motifs.description: Isolate the distant right horizon: low rounded hills, flat sandbars, thin shoreline bands, tiny vegetation dots, and the pale far mountain form at the extreme right. Exclude the calligraphy above.
must_preserve: pale mountain wash at far right

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
